result.instructions: Tools for Autumn, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Autumn data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run autumn_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run autumn_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run autumn_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. autumn_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Fetch a single Autumn customer by id, optionally expanding related data (invoices, entities, subscriptions, balances). Autumn API: POST /v1/customers.get.

customer_id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer.

expand.description: Related data to expand, e.g. invoices, entities, subscriptions.plan, purchases.plan, balances.feature.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List/filter customers with cursor pagination. Autumn API: POST /v1/customers.list. Returns { list, next_cursor }.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor` (omit / empty for first page).

plans.description: Filter by plan: array of { id, versions? } objects.

subscription_status.description: Filter by status: "active" or "scheduled". Defaults to both.

search.description: Search customers by id, name, or email.

processors.description: Filter by processor type: stripe, revenuecat, vercel.

tools.name: check
tools.title: Check feature access / balance
tools.description: READ-ONLY entitlement check: does a customer have access to (or enough balance of) a feature? Autumn API: POST /v1/balances.check. This tool never records usage — it does not expose send_event or lock.

feature_id.description: The ID of the feature to check.

entity_id.description: Entity id for entity-scoped balances (e.g. per-seat limits).

required_balance.description: Minimum balance required for access. Returns allowed:false if below. Defaults to 1.

with_preview.description: Include upgrade/upsell (paywall) info in the response when access is denied.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with cursor pagination and optional filters. Autumn API: POST /v1/invoices.list. Returns { list, next_cursor }.

customer_id.description: Filter to a single customer by id.

entity_id.description: Filter to a single entity by id (must be paired with customer_id).

status.description: Filter by invoice status: draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor` (omit / empty for first page).

tools.name: get_entity
tools.title: Get an entity
tools.description: Fetch a single entity (e.g. a seat) belonging to a customer. Autumn API: POST /v1/entities.get.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer that owns the entity.

expand.description: Related data to expand, e.g. invoices, entities, subscriptions.plan, purchases.plan, balances.feature.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.title: List entities
tools.description: List a customer's entities with cursor pagination and optional filters. Autumn API: POST /v1/entities.list. Returns { list, next_cursor }.

customer_id.description: Restrict the response to entities owned by this customer id.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor` (omit / empty for first page).

plans.description: Filter by plan: array of { id, versions? } objects.

subscription_status.description: Filter by status: "active" or "scheduled". Defaults to both.

search.description: Search entities by id or name.

processors.description: Filter by parent customer processor: stripe, revenuecat, vercel.

tools.name: list_features
tools.title: List features
tools.description: List all features in the current environment. Autumn API: POST /v1/features.list. Returns { list }.

tools.name: get_feature
tools.title: Get a feature
tools.description: Fetch a single feature by id. Autumn API: POST /v1/features.get.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List all plans (products) in the current environment. Autumn API: POST /v1/plans.list. Returns { list }.

customer_id.description: Include eligibility info (trial availability, attach scenario) for this customer.

all_versions.description: If true, include all plan versions.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Get a plan
tools.description: Fetch a single plan by id (optionally a specific version). Autumn API: POST /v1/plans.get.

plan_id.description: The ID of the plan to retrieve.

version.description: The plan version to get. Defaults to the latest.

tools.name: preview_attach
tools.title: Preview attaching a plan
tools.description: Preview the cost/effect of attaching a plan to a customer WITHOUT charging or changing anything. Read-only. Autumn API: POST /v1/billing.preview_attach.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to attach the plan to.

entity_id.description: The ID of the entity to attach the plan to.

feature_quantities.description: Prepaid feature quantities: array of { feature_id, quantity?, adjustable? }.

version.description: The version of the plan to attach.

customize.description: Optional plan overrides (price, items, licenses, free trial).

tools.name: autumn_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: POST to any Autumn read/preview endpoint not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — the path is validated to only allow .get / .list / .check / .preview_* actions; write actions are rejected. Autumn API: POST {path}.

path.description: Full API path, e.g. "/v1/customers.get". Only read/preview suffixes are allowed.

body.description: JSON body object to POST (the endpoint's params).

tools.name: get_or_create_customer
tools.title: Get or create a customer
tools.description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — fetches a customer by id, creating them if they do not exist. Autumn API: POST /v1/customers.get_or_create.

customer_id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer (null to create an anonymous customer).

fingerprint.description: Unique identifier to detect duplicate customers / prevent free-trial abuse.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata for the customer.

stripe_id.description: Existing Stripe customer id, if any.

create_in_stripe.description: Whether to create the customer in Stripe.

currency.description: Currency to bill this customer in (e.g. usd, eur).

expand.description: Related data to expand, e.g. invoices, entities, subscriptions.plan, purchases.plan, balances.feature.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — partially updates a customer. Only provided fields change. Autumn API: POST /v1/customers.update.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer to update.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata for the customer.

currency.description: Currency to bill this customer in (e.g. usd, eur).

tools.name: track_usage
tools.title: Track usage
tools.description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — records a usage event (deducts/credits a feature balance). Provide EITHER feature_id OR event_name. Autumn API: POST /v1/balances.track.

feature_id.description: The feature to track usage for. Provide this OR event_name.

event_name.description: Event name to track usage for. Provide this OR feature_id.

value.description: Amount of usage to record. Defaults to 1. Negative values credit the balance.

properties.description: Additional properties to attach to the usage event.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (ms) for the event. Defaults to now.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key to dedupe retried events.

tools.name: attach_plan
tools.title: Attach a plan
tools.description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — attaches (subscribes) a plan to a customer; may create an invoice / return a payment URL. Autumn API: POST /v1/billing.attach. Returns { customer_id, invoice, payment_url, required_action }.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to attach the plan to.

entity_id.description: The ID of the entity to attach the plan to.

feature_quantities.description: Prepaid feature quantities: array of { feature_id, quantity?, adjustable? }.

version.description: The version of the plan to attach.

success_url.description: URL to redirect to after a successful checkout.

redirect_mode.description: Checkout redirect mode: always, if_required, or never.

invoice_mode.description: Invoice-mode configuration object (send an invoice instead of auto-charging).

checkout_session_params.description: Extra Stripe checkout session params (can carry metadata).

customize.description: Optional plan overrides (price, items, licenses, free trial).

tools.name: create_entity
tools.title: Create an entity
tools.description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — creates an entity (e.g. a seat) under a customer, tied to a feature. Autumn API: POST /v1/entities.create.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to create the entity for.

feature_id.description: The ID of the feature this entity is associated with.

billing_controls.description: Optional billing controls for the entity (spend/usage limits).

tools.name: open_customer_portal
tools.title: Open customer billing portal
tools.description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — creates a Stripe billing-portal session for a customer to manage their subscription. Autumn API: POST /v1/billing.open_customer_portal. Returns { customer_id, url }.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to open the billing portal for.

return_url.description: URL to redirect to when the back button is clicked in the portal.
